'''Nathan Martin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] in October 2000 with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team]], according to Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1338">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cardsd1338/ deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cards], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 13 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cardsd1338/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
